content:
The **Paddle Ball** is a melee weapon in *Fallout 76*.

A small, wooden paddle ball toy marked with an image of Mr. Fuzzy. It deals little damage without modifications.

| **Ball** | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | 
| Mod | Description | Naming | Effects | | | | | | | | | Plan | Components | Form ID | | 
| Rubber ball | Standard. | – | – | – | – | – | – | – | – | – | – | – | Rubber x4 | 00113722 | | 
| Bladed ball | Targets bleed. Better damage. | – | – | +20% + | – | – | – | – | – | +20% | +30% | – | Adhesive x1 Rubber x3 Steel x6 | 00113723 | | 
| Electrified ball | Adds Electrical damage. | – | – | +10 | – | – | – | – | – | – | – | – | Adhesive x1 Aluminum x2 Circuitry x2 Gold x2 Rubber x3 | 00113C6D | | 
| Fire ball | Adds Fire damage. | – | – | +18 | – | – | – | – | – | – | – | – | Adhesive x2 Asbestos x2 Circuitry x2 Copper x3 Rubber x3 | 00113C6B | | 
| Spiked ball | Armor piercing. Better damage. | – | – | +20% | – | – | +2 | – | – | +20% | +30% | – | Adhesive x1 Rubber x3 Steel x3 | 00113C6A | |
